label: Compare inclusive actual-order explanation with contained contingent bruteness
summary: See docs/notes/explanatory-adequacy-750.md#restricted-bruteness-local-success-versus-exact-order-explanation-2026-11-25. Draft PR-1968 continues PR-1872/1908/1910/1927/1933. Distinguishes local derivative, structural, generic-role and inclusive actuality explananda. Under the proposed scope principle, the latter cannot be fully answered while its included B lacks an adequate reason; does not imply universal existential coverage. Two populated finite worlds retain one brute contingent base each, all derivative reason assignments, fixed identities, invariant constraints and a correct resident-observer identity decoder. Role-only observations cannot distinguish occupants uniformly; conditioning on the actual essentially dependent D0 screens off its base-absence world. Finite assignments and rational probability samples checked with a standalone Python diagnostic, not a Lean certificate. A necessary exemption can be directly warranted without falling within the being-level contingent PSR; even a contingent rule fact is not automatically a being. Positive priority, conditional essence, necessary role occupancy and intrinsic self-intelligibility have distinct explanatory scopes. The inspected firstMoverNecessaryByEsseCause proof uses B2 only at its selected f; a mover-scoped strength restriction is proposed, not registered or checked for novelty. Retain BX1/BX2 and actual firstness/priority/existence premises. A nonnecessitating actual reason may explain the recipient without uniquely determining an act; scope, operative content and actual production remain separate. No premise established, no new formal edge or source claim. Prior accepted E/D and practical-content assessments remain intact. Continuation at 2f4005e1a1129f8609967a683bee97a570565b0a, docs/notes/explanatory-adequacy-750.md#restricted-bruteness-intrinsic-reason-actual-application-and-fundamentality-2026-11-25: natureModel's world-free identity condition plus existing global Sound entails existence at every represented world, hence B6 on the contingency witness; proposed proof only, not Lean elaborated or novelty-checked. Original selfNature countermodel does not assert global Sound; target-existence gating restores Sound while preserving the selected-world own-nature token and B2 failure, without warrant for its adequacy. In any sound reason model a specific actual reason for an absent-at-an-accessible-world bearer cannot persist there. Necessity of content alone need not give that edge transport. Five matched fact-level assignments preserve all truth profiles and distinguish a borrowed cycle, unexplained primitive application, nonnecessitating nature reason and represented contingent-fact coverage. Standalone finite diagnostic passed. Positive nonreceipt licenses and ontic reasons remain distinct. A proposed external-reason availability weakening of BX1 retains PSR and BX2 and is structurally weaker by the existing conserved/selfAndOccasion control; combined mover-scoping is pending canonical preflight. No new verified edge or warrant status; preserve the prior judgment.
blocker: An adequate actual nature-to-existence reason for a positively characterized contingent nonreceiving bearer remains unestablished. The same-world reason token, its world-relative applicability, and its substantive direction/relevance must be distinguished. Global Sound of the world-free natureModel would entail B6, but its existential import is the open application premise. Compare an actual nonnecessitating intrinsic ground, constitutive actual ground with complete inputs, and principled nonreceipt stopping license using #1621/#1810/#1638 and C2/B6; do not repeat fixed-law or reason-token assignments. Universal adequacy-to-token/domain coverage and BX2 remain OPEN. Mover-scoped coverage and external-reason-availability weakening of BX1 need related/novelty/semantics preflight, Lean elaboration, binding and certificate checks before registration. The strongest rational and impersonal necessary-source accounts retain the operative-content/channel blockers of #1933. No general epistemic deficit inferred. Independent semantic challenge and canonical validation outstanding.

current_assessment.scope: Inclusive existence scope, intrinsic reason transport and fundamentality, role occupancy, epistemic screening and same-mover reason coverage
current_assessment.assessment: Proposed unreviewed synthesis: a contained brute input leaves the inclusive actual-existence question unanswered if that question covers the very base and the scope principle is accepted. This is explanatory incompleteness, not a contradiction, independent derivative bruteness or universal epistemic failure. Fixed-role constraints, a positive exemption criterion and reliable cognitive inference are compatible with the displayed structural assignments. Essential identity information may remove occupant ambiguity, without supplying an ontic why. A necessary source with adequate actual nonnecessitating production could improve the comparison, but no such adequate source or personal-over-impersonal ranking is established. Retain the earlier moderate preference for E and suspension about D; no change to their accepted review status. The exact world-free natureModel with global Sound rules out contingency of its identity-conditioned bearer; this isolates rather than warrants the existential import. World-relative factive nonnecessitating reason assignments survive without fixed-edge transport; co-truth cannot distinguish borrowing from constitutive direction. A positively justified nonreceipt license can permit a primitive causal stop without supplying an ontic why. Selected external reason availability may replace universal BX1 for the conditional route, pending canonical formalization; no reduction of the philosophical burden of explaining the first mover's existence is claimed.
current_assessment.next_test: Test a positively characterized nonreceiving candidate first mover's nature as an actual existential reason, using the #1621 intrinsic-boundary case, #1810/#1638 real-esse/constitutive-ground work and C2/B6 reception results. Distinguish an independently obtaining nature-fact with nonnecessitating relevance from an existence-gated token, a genuine constitutive ground with full actual inputs, and a primitive-stop license with no ontic reason. For the same bearer, test whether nonreceipt implies lack of dependence in the relevant existential sense rather than merely lack of productive predecessor. Run related/novelty/semantics on the proposed sound-nature consequence and one-external-reason/mover-scoped weakening before registration. Preserve BX2, B0/B1/B3, explicit EM and same witness; no independent warrant from rephrasing. Reopen epistemic cost only for a specified non-discriminating channel and lack of other warrant.
